title: spaceId declared server-set but clients must supply it at creation
description: Section 3 (FileNode Extension Property) says spaceId is 'server-set' and 'immutable', but Section 3 (Discovery) says clients MAY create the root via FileNode/set. If the client creates the root, the server cannot know which Space to associate without the client providing spaceId. Decide: either the client supplies spaceId at creation (server validates), or a separate mechanism triggers tree creation. Current text is contradictory.
